svg.title: OSIRIS JSON Cisco Catalyst C8200L-1N-4T front chassis
svg.desc: An original editable flat gray vector of a Cisco Catalyst C8200L-1N-4T edge router with console and USB ports, two RJ45 WAN ports, two SFP WAN ports, an LTE PIM module, and a NIM bay.
